findings.summary: The plan's Status block says "The plan is complete and stays live until the branch merges" — the wrong retention rule for this base. `skills/pr/SKILL.md` Step 1d and the Merge Flow both say that on gitflow the plan is RETAINED live past the develop merge and archived only by the develop->main release (`plan-backfill`); this repo already took a blocking Critic finding once for an early archive (rev-20260813T042938Z-81decaea). The concrete wrong action is archiving the plan at this merge. Remedy is deletion or a relational pointer, not a reworded narration: cut "until the branch merges" outright, or make it relational — "stays live until the develop->main release archives it (pr/SKILL.md, gitflow RETAIN)". Note the same sentence is already in `.prawduct/artifacts/build-plan-silent-governance-failures.md:74` on develop, so this is a copied idiom rather than a new invention; sweeping both is one edit and can ride the next `.prawduct/` commit. `prawduct-hook cost-of-commit` reports this path FREE — the fix moves no coverage and buys no review round, so accepting it is a weaker answer than fixing it here. Worth noting that this is a live instance of the learning this very branch adds ("When operator prose restates a PREDICATE, diff your sentence against the rule's canonical prose statement").

The bundle introduces `critic_consolidate.name_paths()` as "the shared spelling for a path list in a message" (3 call sites), then writes a second, hand-rolled spelling of the same truncation twice more in `evidence._cmd_list` — the pre-existing `free=[...]` block and the new `excluded=[...]` block beside it, at width 3 instead of 5. Only visible across the bundle: one chunk created the shared helper and another added a competing copy next to it. Not free to collapse — `critic_consolidate` imports `evidence`, so the helper would have to move down into `evidence` or a shared util rather than be imported upward, and `prawduct-hook cost-of-commit plugin/lib/evidence.py` prices the fix at one verify-resolutions round (~5 min). Recommendation: ACCEPT for this PR, or let it ride along with the next commit that already touches `evidence.py` — the two widths are deliberate and nothing is wrong today. Worth writing down on #723 (which already carries the one-authoring-home construction work for this bundle's other duplication class) rather than dropping it silently.
